big_story.headline: Inflation Breaches Limit
big_story.subhead: RETAIL INFLATION HITS 6.1% AS ECONOMISTS WARN OF RATE HIKES BY THE RBI
paragraphs: India's retail inflation has crossed the central bank's upper limit for the first time in two years, coming in at 6.1% for October 2026. The print above the threshold has immediately bolstered the case for policy tightening, forcing markets to re-evaluate the trajectory of borrowing costs.

As consumer price pressures build up, economists suggest the Reserve Bank of India may consider rate hikes by up to 50 bps in FY27. This shift in the macro landscape comes even as broader economic indicators show resilience, putting monetary policymakers in a tight spot.

For investors and borrowers alike, the return of elevated inflation signals an end to the prolonged pause in interest rates. Markets will be closely watching subsequent data releases and central bank commentary for clues on upcoming policy actions.
big_story.pullbox: Retail inflation crossing the RBI limit alters the monetary policy outlook, bringing rate hikes back to the forefront.

explains.title: What is Retail Inflation?
paragraphs: Retail inflation measures changes in the price level of a basket of consumer goods and services bought directly by households. In India, it is tracked primarily through the Consumer Price Index.
When this index rises beyond the central bank's comfort band, the cost of living increases, prompting the monetary authority to raise interest rates to cool down aggregate demand.

Olyv has successfully raised ₹57.62 Crore in an extended Series C funding round led by Nippon India Digital. The capital injection provides fresh momentum to the platform as it expands its footprint in the competitive financial services landscape.

Backed by institutional investors, the fresh funds will support Olyv's strategic growth initiatives and scaling plans. The round highlights sustained investor appetite for robust digital-first financial platforms in India.

story_1.headline: 7th Global Fintech Fest 2026 Kicks Off
paragraphs: The 7th Global Fintech Fest 2026 has officially commenced, bringing together industry leaders, policymakers, and innovators from across the financial sector. Discussions at the premier event focus on emerging technologies, digital payments, and the evolving regulatory landscape shaping the future of finance.

As India continues to cement its position as a digital payments powerhouse, the summit serves as a crucial platform for forging strategic partnerships. Stakeholders are examining how next-generation platforms can drive broader financial inclusion while maintaining robust security frameworks.

story_2.headline: Leaders Discuss India's Economic Future at TIME
paragraphs: Corporate leaders gathered at the TIME Impact Dinner to discuss the future trajectory of India's economy. Discussions centered on sustainable growth drivers, infrastructural developments, and the macroeconomic headwinds currently facing various sectors.

Participants emphasized the importance of innovation and policy consistency in maintaining high growth rates. The high-profile gathering underscored growing global confidence in India's long-term economic potential.

story_3.headline: RBI Issues New Domestic Transfer Guidelines
paragraphs: The Reserve Bank of India has rolled out new domestic transfer guidelines aimed at streamlining fund movements across financial institutions. The updated framework seeks to enhance transparency, bolster security, and improve processing speeds for everyday banking customers.

geopolitics.headline: India and Canada Eye December Trade Pact in 6th Talk Round
paragraphs: India and Canada have opened their sixth round of trade negotiations as both nations work toward concluding a bilateral trade pact by December 2026. A Canadian Minister confirmed that talks are progressing swiftly ahead of an expected visit by Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi to Canada next month. The negotiating teams are focusing on expanding market access and deepening bilateral commercial ties across key sectors.

While negotiators are pushing for a December conclusion, final tariff schedules and regulatory frameworks are still being hammered out. A completed agreement could significantly expand trade channels for Indian exporters across North American supply chains. Business leaders are closely watching whether the final terms will provide tariff relief and smoother market access for services and goods.

big_story.headline: Inflation Reaches 6% Threshold While Economic Growth Remains Steady
big_story.text: India's retail inflation reached 6%, hitting the upper tolerance band of the central bank's monetary framework. Despite elevated price pressures, underlying economic activity is expected to remain resilient in the coming quarters. This development highlights the delicate policy balancing act required by monetary authorities to curb inflation without dampening growth.

big_story.headline: Oil India Reports 116% Surge in Q2 Standalone PAT
big_story.text: State-owned Oil India recorded a 116% jump in its standalone profit after tax for Q2 FY27. The substantial increase demonstrates strong operational performance across its upstream oil and gas exploration assets. This robust performance provides a boost to India's public sector energy space amid volatile global crude dynamics.

venture_vault.headline: Rigi Secures ₹10 Crore Funding From Google at ₹670 Crore Valuation
venture_vault.text: Creator economy platform Rigi has raised ₹10 crore from tech giant Google, valuing the startup at ₹670 crore. The strategic investment will support Rigi in expanding its platform tools for digital creators across the country. Google's participation underlines the growing investor interest in India's creator-led digital commerce landscape.

venture_vault.headline: Hundo Pizza Secures ₹7.5 Crore Round Led by Titan Capital
venture_vault.text: Food startup Hundo Pizza has raised ₹7.5 crore in its maiden institutional funding round, led by venture firm Titan Capital. The fresh infusion of capital will primarily drive the brand's retail expansion across Mumbai. The deal highlights steady investor interest in India's growing quick-service restaurant and food technology segments.

geopolitics.headline: PM Modi Meets Swiss President to Boost Trade and Tech Ties
geopolitics.text: Prime Minister Narendra Modi met with the President of Switzerland on the sidelines of the AI Impact Summit to discuss expanding bilateral cooperation. Discussions focused on enhancing trade relations, attracting foreign direct investment, and advancing technology partnerships. The meeting highlights India's effort to leverage global summits to deepen economic engagement with key European partners.

geopolitics.headline: PM Modi to Attend ASEAN Summit in Manila from Nov 16 to 18
geopolitics.text: Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to attend the upcoming ASEAN Summit in Manila, set to take place from November 16 to 18. The visit aims to strengthen diplomatic and economic ties between India and Southeast Asian nations under India's Act East policy. High-level multilateral discussions will cover regional security, trade corridors, and supply chain resilience.
